releases.name: Version 1.2.0
releases.body:
- Made Ernesto easier to talk to.
- Added a couple of custom endings (a third is planned but not currently implemented).
- Added achievements using Achievements+ (a list of them can be found in the readme).

releases.name: Version 1.1.3
releases.body:
- Added a Japanese translation (thanks nepyanagi!)
- Updated Korean translation
- Added a file to help translators with text that is not caught by NH's translation generation tool

releases.name: Version 1.1.2
releases.body:
- Prevented a certain seed from progressing states too early.
- A sit sequence now lasts longer
- Update Korean translation
- Changed an end-of-mod song

releases.name: Version 1.1.0
releases.body:
- Made a certain gravity thing wider so that it's easier to stay in it.
- Made it more clear that a certain receptacle starts off full.
- Made it so that any signal can be locked on to now, regardless of attachment to a valid body.
- Put an interactor on a special boy to make people not so nervous.
- Made a certain cave harder to cheese.
- Redid bundle management to be better.
- Gave a certain dome a bit more of a landmark.
